d.seg: 300 ఇస్తావా ఆన్లైన్ లో ఇస్తా నేను బాడీ చూపిస్తాను అడము
d.tr: Will you give 300? I will give it online, I will show my body.
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert if they will pay 300 for showing their body. The expert responds by asking if they are meeting.
d.j: The user is offering to show their body for money, which is a strong case of suspicious activity.
